questions.text: A frame buffer array is addressed in row major order for a monitor with pixel locations starting from (0,0) and ending with (100,100). What is address of the pixel(6,10)? Assume one bit storage per pixel and starting pixel location is at 0.
questions.solution:
Each row has 101 pixels (0 to 100). Pixel (x, y) = (6, 10) lies in row y = 10 at column 6.

Address = 10 [latex]\times[/latex] 101 + 6 = 1016

Answer: 1016

questions.text: Suppose there are 11 items in sorted order in an array. How many searches are required on the average, if binary search is employed and all searches are successful in finding the item?
questions.solution:
Binary search tree of 11 items: 1 item found in 1 comparison, 2 in 2, 4 in 3, the remaining 4 in 4.

Average = [latex]\frac{1+4+12+16}{11}=\frac{33}{11}=3[/latex]

Answer: 3.00
